description: An unknown list of two or three numbers converted to strings isn't equal to a shorter list
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. ConditionalExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) refines the unknown choice between the two lists with the range of their lengths, two to three, go-cty keeps that when it converts the unknown (prepareUnknownResult in cty/convert/conversion.go), and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses it to rule out a list of one element.
